user.title: OKC Services
user.description: Enter your Oklahoma City service address. It is matched against City of Oklahoma City open data to find your trash, recycling and bulky waste collection zones.

data_description.address: For example: 200 N Walker Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73102

confirm.title: Confirm your address
confirm.description:
Matched address:
**{address}**

Coordinates: `{latitude}, {longitude}`

Is this correct?

options.title: Map options
options.description: Control which live fire and police responses, and which active street work zones, appear on your map. You can change all of this later under Configure.

data.incidents_enabled: Show emergency responses on the map
data.incident_types: Only show these call types (leave empty for all)
data.work_zones_enabled: Show active work zones on the map
data.work_zone_types: Only show these work types (leave empty for all)

data_description.incident_radius: In miles. Addresses on the edge of the city may need 10 to 20 miles to reach the busier parts of Oklahoma City.
data_description.incident_types: Matching is partial, so "Fire" also matches "Fire: Elevator Emergency".
data_description.work_zone_radius: In miles. The city publishes around 190 work zones at once, so a tighter radius than the incident feed usually reads better on the map.
data_description.work_zone_types: Matching is partial, so "Street" also matches "Street/Sidewalk Repair".

error.address_not_found: That address could not be found. Try including the city, state and ZIP code.
error.outside_service_area: That address is not inside any City of Oklahoma City collection zone. Trash service there is likely provided by another municipality or a private hauler.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Oklahoma City open data services. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.
